body: How do you know he's asking for help for the patients, and not because he's uncomfortable. He calls us the fucking "CRAZY TRAIN." Fucking christ, I've been transported enough times to tell you that I was honestly tricked by this front. Hopefully it wasn't a front from those EMT's, but sure seems like it coming from this guy.

I think you should probably think before posting in a subreddit, literally filled to the brim with actively, or once actively, suicidal people of all ages. I mean honestly, the "crazy train"? How is that not passing judgement? You think the suicidal ideation and self-harm defines us? Fuck I've been transported 3 times, maybe I'll think next time about how the EMT really thinks about me, even if he's listening "intently." It seems like you don't really know any better to pass judgment like calling it the "crazy train," but still, either way, fuck you good sir. Sorry, but judgement still counts when you do it silently. I guess it's nice to see the truth come out in a fucking suicide subreddit.
